page.overview:
Who is Yasmina Fadoula?

Yasmina is a multi-medal world track and field champion whose corporate sponsor was Jurassic World. However, due to constant training, she has not had time to have fun or make real friends, as her training regimen has led her to lead a disciplined and solitary life.

In the winter of 2015, Yaz was invited to participate in the Camp Cretaceous.

Yaz arrived on Isla Nublar at the Ferry Landing along with the other campers, and is greeted by Dave and Roxie. They are then taken to Camp Cretaceous, only stopping briefly when the counselors attempt to retrieve an escaped Compsognathus. Once at camp, Brooklynn tries to interview her as an athlete but Yaz simply avoids her, saying that she doesn't like being in front of cameras. That afternoon, all the campers, including Yasmina, have the opportunity to zipline over a herd of dinosaurs.

The next day, Yaz and the rest of the group (excluding Darius and Kenji, who were being punished for entering the Raptor Paddock) visit the Genetics Lab. She is present at Bumpy's birth, however she and the rest of the group are abruptly expelled by Dr. Wu in retaliation for Brooklynn's invasion of his office. When asked by Darius and Kenji, she stated that Brooklynn got them booted from the lab, officially nicknaming her "Superstar" for the first time.
